propositions: Capability decisions currently use provider name string matching (startswith, frozenset literals) instead of reading ModelProfile, causing Bedrock-hosted Claude to silently lose prompt caching and structured output support because its model string says 'bedrock' not 'anthropic'

Two new string-match branches (output_mode checking _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS; runner.py checking startswith('anthropic')) must be replaced by a single ModelCapabilities record derived from model.profile fields

capabilities_for() must accept both model objects (with .profile) and lazy model strings (for providers like openai/google that rebar defers), resolving strings via a _PROFILE_RESOLVERS map into pydantic_ai.profiles.* records without importing optional SDKs

The override table must use predicate functions reading profile type and fields only (not provider strings or model strings), with _is_claude() spanning both AnthropicModelProfile and Bedrock-hosted Claude (BedrockModelProfile with bedrock_thinking_variant='anthropic') to enforce native_structured_output=False for Claude on all hosts

cache_settings_for(caps: ModelCapabilities) replaces _anthropic_cache_settings(resolved: str), dispatching on prompt_cache_style to return AnthropicModelSettings, BedrockModelSettings, or None, with caching enabled for Bedrock-hosted Claude

A profile-missing or unrecognized model degrades to conservative record (native_structured_output=False, prompt_cache_style='none') plus exactly one WARNING log, never raising, so unknown providers do not break runs
